feature: Billing Document Creation with Batch and Quality Management Validation

envDependencies.SAP_FIORI_URL: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_FIORI_URL} in navigation steps
envDependencies.SAP_USERNAME: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_USERNAME} in login steps
envDependencies.SAP_PASSWORD: Read from .env — used as {ENV.SAP_PASSWORD} in login steps

TD-CS-042-001.name: Valid Billing Document — Approved Batch and Released Quality Status
TD-CS-042-001.expectedOutcome: Billing document created with unique document number; status Posted; references delivery, batch, and inspection lot

TD-CS-042-NEG-001.name: Negative — Batch Status Restricted/Blocked
TD-CS-042-NEG-001.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'Batch X is restricted'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-NEG-002.name: Negative — Quality Inspection Status Not Released
TD-CS-042-NEG-002.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'Usage decision not made' or 'Inspection lot not released'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-NEG-003.name: Negative — Non-existent Delivery
TD-CS-042-NEG-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'Delivery document does not exist'; no delivery data loaded; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-NEG-004.name: Negative — Delivery Already Fully Billed (Duplicate Billing)
TD-CS-042-NEG-004.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'Delivery already billed' or 'No remaining quantity available for billing'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-NEG-005.name: Negative — No Quality Inspection Lot Created
TD-CS-042-NEG-005.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'No inspection lot found' or 'Quality inspection missing'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-ERR-001.name: Error — Missing Mandatory Field: Delivery
TD-CS-042-ERR-001.note: deliveryNumber intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-042-ERR-001.expectedOutcome: System highlights Delivery field as mandatory; prevents submission; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-ERR-002.name: Error — Missing Mandatory Field: Billing Type
TD-CS-042-ERR-002.note: billingType intentionally empty to test mandatory field enforcement
TD-CS-042-ERR-002.expectedOutcome: System highlights Billing Type field as mandatory; prevents submission; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-ERR-003.name: Error — Invalid Delivery Reference Format
TD-CS-042-ERR-003.expectedOutcome: System displays error: 'Invalid delivery number format'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-EDGE-001.name: Edge Case — Multiple Batches (Partial Release Scenario)
TD-CS-042-EDGE-001.expectedOutcome: Billing document created with all batches; status Posted; all batch and quality validations passed

TD-CS-042-EDGE-002.name: Edge Case — Quality Status Changes During Billing Process (Concurrent Update)
TD-CS-042-EDGE-002.note: Inspection lot usage decision changes from 'Accepted' to 'Rejected' during billing process via concurrent QM session
TD-CS-042-EDGE-002.expectedOutcome: System detects concurrent quality status change at final validation; displays error: 'Usage decision not made'; billing document NOT created

TD-CS-042-EDGE-003.name: Edge Case — Minimum Billing Quantity (Partial Billing)
TD-CS-042-EDGE-003.expectedOutcome: Billing document created with partial billing quantity (minimum); status Posted; delivery remains partially billed

TD-CS-042-EDGE-004.name: Edge Case — Billing Date at Posting Period Boundary
TD-CS-042-EDGE-004.note: Billing date set to last day of fiscal posting period (e.g., 2026-12-31 for period 012.2026)
TD-CS-042-EDGE-004.expectedOutcome: Billing document created with period boundary date; status Posted; fiscal period validation passed

TD-CS-042-INT-001.name: Integration — SD-QM Quality Status Lookup from QALS
TD-CS-042-INT-001.expectedOutcome: SD-QM integration successful; quality status read from QALS; billing document created with inspection lot reference

TD-CS-042-INT-002.name: Integration — SD-MM Batch Status Validation from MCH1
TD-CS-042-INT-002.expectedOutcome: SD-MM integration successful; batch status read from MCH1; billing document created with batch reference
